title: Starting on drums around 1914 and Army band
summary: He began on drums about 1914, working for a boss, and later went into the Army band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Franky Deuce, yeah. What was your first instrument? Did you start on drums? Started on drums, yeah. Started on drums. How come you liked- Did you like drums when you were a boy? What age were you when you started?

No. Well, I was a good age. I was working, you know. Yeah. And played for the work with Slack. Mm-hmm. Probably in Bonnet Petit took me first. Oh, yeah. Yeah, yeah. Well, I got more money I was making that. And the boss sent for me, so I quit. So I kept on playing. I went to the Army. I was known with Punch. You were with Punch? In the band Army, Punch.
About how old were you when you took up drums? Oh, yeah. What year would that be? Is that after the First World War? Oh, before that, before. Before the war, I think.
